title: Adhyaya 3: Sadhana (The Path of Spiritual Practice)
summary: Examines the nature of reincarnation, dream states, the attributes of Brahman, and meditations (Vidyas).
ai_summary: Badarayana codifies the spiritual disciplines, demonstrating that direct knowledge of Brahman alone yields liberation.

verses.translation: In obtaining another body, the soul goes enveloped by the subtle elements.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: The departing soul carries the subtle body (Sukshma Sharira) containing its karmic tendencies and vital faculties into the next birth.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: जीवात्मा पुनर्जन्म के समय सूक्ष्म तत्वों से आवेष्टित होकर गमन करता है।

verses.translation: Not even on account of place (in various bodies/realms) does the Supreme possess dual characteristics (defect and purity), for everywhere Brahman is declared as devoid of attributes.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Brahman dwells in the heart of all creatures like the sun reflected in pools of water, untouched by the blemishes of the medium.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: परमात्मा सभी उपाधियों में रहकर भी सर्वथा निर्दोष और निर्विकार रहता है।

verses.original: प्रकृतैतावत्त्वं हि प्रतिषेधति ततो ब्रवीति च भूयः ॥
verses.transliteration: prakṛtaitāvattvaṁ hi pratiṣedhati tato bravīti ca bhūyaḥ ||
verses.translation: For the negative declaration 'Not this, Not this' denies only the limited forms previously described, and then scripture affirms Brahman's transcendent reality beyond.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: 'Neti, Neti' is not nihilism; it eliminates false superimpositions (Adhyasa) to reveal the indestructible substratum of awareness.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: 'नेति नेति' केवल उपाधियों और परिमित रूपों का निषेध करता है, परब्रह्म के अस्तित्व का नहीं।

verses.translation: The meditations taught in all the Upanishads refer to the one same Reality, because the injunctions and essential characteristics are non-different.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Different Vedic branches describe meditations under various names (Dahara Vidya, Shandilya Vidya), but their core object is the singular Brahman.

layers.author: ramanujacharya
layers.content: समस्त उपनिषदों की विद्याएं एक ही परब्रह्म की उपासना का प्रतिपादन करती हैं।

verses.translation: Through knowledge of Brahman alone the supreme human goal (Moksha) is attained, so declares Badarayana from scriptural testimony.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: Liberation is not an effect of ritual actions (Karma), which are finite. Direct Self-knowledge (Jnana) destroys ignorance and reveals timeless Freedom.

layers.author: adi-shankara
layers.content: ब्रह्मविद्या से ही परम पुरुषार्थ (मोक्ष) की प्राप्ति होती है।
